title: Assertion: Packet Validity
constraints: Rule 1: every valid beat carries even parity: `parity == ^data`.
Rule 2: `last` may only be high together with `valid`.
Rule 3: a packet is at most 8 beats: after 8 valid beats without `last`, the 8th must have had `last`.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Rule 3 needs a beat counter in the checker: count valid beats, reset it on `last`, and assert `valid && beats == 7 |-> last`.
(X-checks with `$isunknown` are common here too, but Verilator is a 2-state simulator, so it can't show X values.)

examples.title: ok
examples.input: 3 beats with correct parity, last on the 3rd

examples.title: parity
examples.input: a beat with the wrong parity bit
